pages.text: $(l)Shift + right-click$() one of your recruits to open $(l)Recruit Command$(). A normal right-click still opens Villager Recruits' own menu. You can also bind a key to command the recruit under your crosshair (Controls).$(br2)From the City Manager's Garrison list, $(l)Command$() opens the same screen and $(l)Inventory$() opens a soldier's inventory.

$(l)Pages$()$(li)$(l)Overview$(): health, morale, kills, levels, gear, quick orders (follow, hold, wander), rename$(li)$(l)Skills$(), $(l)Weapons$(), $(l)Legendary$(), $(l)Special skills$()$(li)$(l)Promotions$()$(li)$(l)Inventory$(): opens the recruit's equipment$(br2)Recruits hired the normal way can $(l)Enlist$() in your nearest town to use skills and town upkeep.
